tools.name: kural_guidance
tools.description: CALL FIRST for any personal, emotional, moral, family or life-guidance message — hurt, lies, betrayal, grief, worry, anger, uncertainty, forgiveness, meaning — even when the user never mentions the Thirukkural (“my parents lied to me”, “she betrayed me”, “I feel lost”). Grounds your answer in a veri

tools.name: verify_quote
tools.description: CALL THIS BEFORE QUOTING any Thirukkural verse — it letter-checks the quotation against the canonical corpus (Tamil or English accepted). Returns {verified, kural_id, tamil, english} on a match; when verified is false, do not present the quote — fetch a verified one with kural_guidance.
